description: This file defines a class 'Depreciation' that provides numerical computations for various depreciation methods such as DB, DDB, SLN, and SYD, used for financial asset depreciation calculations in a spreadsheet context.

classes.name: Depreciation
classes.description: A class providing static methods for various depreciation calculations in financial contexts.

methods.name: DB
methods.description: Calculates depreciation using the fixed-declining balance method for a given period.

methods.name: DDB
methods.description: Calculates depreciation using the double-declining balance method or other specified methods.

methods.name: SLN
methods.description: Calculates straight-line depreciation for a single period.

methods.name: SYD
methods.description: Calculates sum-of-years' digits depreciation for a given period.
